create_azure_blob_token_provider: create a custom AzureBlobTokenProvider subclass that returns SAS tokens for a specific storage account
read_azure_blob_with_reader: create an AzureBlobReader to stream read a blob from Azure Blob Storage in fixed-size chunks
write_azure_blob_with_writer: create an AzureBlobWriter to stream write data to an Azure blob using staged block uploads
open_azure_blob_path: use AzureBlobPathHandler to open an az:// or blob:// URI for reading or writing blobs
copy_local_to_azure_blob: use AzureBlobPathHandler to copy a local file to an Azure Blob Storage container
